coverage_notes: P0003 is a broad target spanning lines 6–122; clauses model operative terms in that range. External platform rules, product and subscription rules, product documentation, and cited laws are incorporated or referenced but not supplied in full; their contents and the data-retention buffer period cannot be determined here.
The separate model-license terms beginning at line 243 and the adjacent fee schedule are outside the target chunk and are not modeled. No model-license grant, price, or payment duty is inferred.

The agreement states user-uploaded-data ownership but does not grant ownership of or a general license to outputs. The original artifact object is used only as the closest available category for platform services, accounts, data, and content; scope notes specify identity.
